question: Which of the following Tiger Reserves/National Parks and states situated in is INCORRECTLY matched?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Sundarbans National Park - Odisha.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sundarbans National Park - Odisha**, this land results from the **strong tide that is a daily reality in Sunderban.**
 
• Sunderban is **located in the North and South 24 Pargana Districts of the Indian State of West Bengal**.
 
• **Sunderban Biosphere Reserve **at a** total of 9630 sq km**, is the** third largest such reserve in India having got this status in 1989.**
 
• It is **part of the Sundarbans on the Ganges Delta and adjacent to the Sundarban Reserve Forest in Bangladesh. **
 
• **It is located in southwest Bangladesh.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Manas National Park** is a national park,** Project Tiger reserve, biosphere reserve, and elephant reserve in Assam, India. **
 
• **Bandhavgarh National Park** is in the** central Indian state of Madhya Pradesh**. This biodiverse park is known for its** big population of royal Bengal tigers, mainly in the central Tala zone.**
 
• **Jim Corbett National Park is a forested wildlife sanctuary in northern India’s Uttarakhand State.** 
 
• Rich in flowers and animals, it’s known for its Bengal tigers.** Animals, as well as tigers, leopards and wild elephants, roam the Dhikala zone.**
